retrievalProfile.description: A close-up portrait featuring a magnifying glass that enlarges a single eye, paired with textured, hand-drawn display typography.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist sans-serif type is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate portrait of a woman where a brass-rimmed magnifying glass is held in the foreground, significantly enlarging one eye to create a focal point of scrutiny and detail against a soft-focus, warm-toned background.
coreVisualRelationships: The magnifying glass acts as a secondary frame within the primary composition.
The enlarged eye creates a psychological connection between subject and viewer.
Textured typography sits atop the hair, integrating with the subject's form.
Warm skin tones contrast with cool blue and white outlines in the text.
coreInvariants: Optical distortion of the eye through the lens
Brass or metallic rim on the magnifying tool
Soft, diffused lighting on the face
Textured, multi-layered stroke effects on lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, face slightly angled, filling 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The magnified eye positioned in the upper right quadrant of the lens.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Viewer starts at the magnified eye, follows the lens rim down to the handle, then up to the display title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the face and hair occupy most of the canvas with dark shadows on the left edge.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones and golden blonde hair (background/subject).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and purples in the eye makeup and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cerulean blue and white used for typographic outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the eye and text outlines.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma primary colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Casual, upright script with varying baseline
letterConstructionRules: Inner fill has a dry-brush or chalk-like texture
Irregular, hand-drawn jitter in the strokes
Ascenders and descenders are fluid and expressive
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'n' and 'e' have open, airy counters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary smaller signature-style script placed mid-right to balance the magnifying glass handle.
graphicDevices: Metallic reflection on the lens rim

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, intimate feel of the portrait.
Mimics the dry-brush texture of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus close-up portrait of a woman with blonde hair, holding a brass magnifying glass over one eye so the eye appears significantly larger and detailed. Use warm, diffused lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, textured script lettering across the top, using a blue fill with a white chalky outline and a slight drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the eye inside the magnifying glass significantly larger than the other?
Does the text have a visible dry-brush or chalk texture?
Is the lighting soft and intimate rather than harsh?
Is the magnifying glass rim metallic?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Realistic optical distortion in the lens

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic refraction at the edge of the magnifying glass.
Ensure the text is legible despite the texture.
Verify the skin tones are natural and warm.
Confirm the magnifying glass handle does not obscure the mouth.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Optical Tool + Textured Script Overlay
